subject: general
question: Seven friends, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, are sitting in the same line in a class. All are facing the teacher. R is between U and Q. P is between T and V. Q is third to the left of S. T and S are sitting at the corners. Who is sitting third to the right of T?
solution: Seven friends, **P, Q, R, S, T, U and V**, are sitting in the same line in a class. All are facing the teacher. 1. Q is third to the left of S. 2. T and S are sitting at the corners.
